name: china-industrial-economics
description: Use when targeting 《中国工业经济》(China Industrial Economics) — a top journal for industrial organization, firm behavior, regional/innovation/digital economy with empirical rigor and strong policy relevance. Apply when a paper needs exhaustive robustness, clean China-policy quasi-experiments, mechanism + heterogeneity, and actionable industrial-policy implications. Famous for methodological rigor norms.
